name: neo-core
description: Neo core — a coordinated crew of coding agents: a business-engineer orchestrator that drives a PRD through the Specification loop and spawns one session per task, a technical-engineer orchestrator that drives a spec to a draft PR via researcher, implementation-planner, code-writer, and code-reviewer, plus the feature-agent and task-planner specification crew and their authoring skills, a verification-loop orchestrator that proves a change against its spec with evidence and the neo-verification-template skill, with lifecycle-logging hooks. GitHub Copilot CLI manifest.
